# Design estimates (generated by `design/estimates.py`)

Fixed unless stated: beta_e = beta_i = 1.0, omega_pe/Omega_ce = 10.0, M_A = 4.5, rms delta B_x / B0 = 0.6, theta_Bn = 90 deg with B0 in the plane. Assumptions: see the module docstring.

## 1. Rotation of a linear polarization (review, Major 2)

Rotation rate of the plane of a linear polarization = (Re omega_R - Re omega_L) / 2. Cold Hall MHD: k^2 d_i v_A / 2. Kinetic: roots of the parallel Maxwellian dispersion relation (R and L), m_i/m_e = 100.

| k d_i | Hall rate [rad Ω_ci] | kinetic rate [rad Ω_ci] | Im ω_L / Ω_ci | Im ω_R / Ω_ci |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.05 | 0.0013 | 0.0018 | -1.01e-21 | 7.05e-22 |
| 0.10 | 0.0050 | 0.0074 | -1.96e-20 | -1.69e-21 |
| 0.20 | 0.0200 | 0.0301 | -8.47e-08 | -2.70e-16 |
| 0.30 | 0.0450 | 0.0711 | -1.59e-03 | -5.37e-09 |
| 0.50 | 0.1250 | 0.2018 | -6.59e-02 | -5.37e-05 |
| 0.63 | 0.1985 | 0.3031 | -1.44e-01 | -4.00e-04 |

## 2. Field-line excursion Ξ = ξ_x / L_sh (review, Major 3)

L_sh = 0.68 M_A d_i = 3.06 d_i at M_A = 4.5. ξ_pp: median peak-to-peak over 200 random-phase realizations. t_conn = ξ_pp / U1: time during which one field line meets the front more than once. t_along = (L_y / 2) / v_te: thermal transit between two intersections (v_te at m_i/m_e = 100 and 1836).

## 4. Thresholds at simulated and real mass ratios (review, Major 3)

| Threshold | Formula (source) | m_i/m_e = 100 | 400 | 1836 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| whistler critical, θ = 90 / 70 / 45° | 0.5 √(m_i/m_e) cos θ (lindberg2024electron form) | 0.0 / 1.7 / 3.5 | 0.0 / 3.4 / 7.1 | 0.0 / 7.3 / 15.1 |
| whistler injection, θ = 70°, β_e = 1 | (cos θ/2) √(m_i/m_e) √β_e (amano2010critical Eq. 2) | 1.7 | 3.4 | 7.3 |
| surfing trapping (α = 0.2) | (1+α)(m_i/m_e)^(2/3) (bohdan2017electron Eq. 2) | 26 | 65 | 180 |
| SSDA injection, θ = 70° | M_A ≳ 55 cos θ (amano2022theory Eq. 14, factors 1) | 19 (no m_i/m_e) | 19 (no m_i/m_e) | 19 (no m_i/m_e) |
| ion-scale ripples | M_A ≈ 3.5 (trotta2019electron, hybrid) | 3.5 | 3.5 | 3.5 |
